'''Chander Kanta Gupta''' {{postnominals|FRSC}} (8 October 1938 – 27 March 2016)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://obits.dignitymemorial.com/dignity-memorial/obituary.aspx?n=Chander-Gupta&lc=3754&pid=179424986&mid=6863538|title=Chander Gupta Obituary - Thomson In the Park Funeral Home and Cem - Winnipeg MB|website=obits.dignitymemorial.com|accessdate=18 August 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.legacy.com/obituaries/name/chander-gupta-obituary?pid=1000000179424986|title=Chander Gupta Obituary - Winnipeg, Manitoba|date=28 March 2016|website=Legacy.com|accessdate=18 August 2017}}</ref> was a Canadian distinguished professor of mathematics at the [[University of Manitoba]], known for her research in [[abstract algebra]] and [[group theory]].<ref>[http://umanitoba.ca/faculties/science/about/768.html Distinguished Professors of the Faculty of Science] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160813103723/http://umanitoba.ca/faculties/science/about/768.html |date=13 August 2016 }}, Univ. of Manitoba, retrieved 2015-06-09.</ref> Much of her research concerns the [[automorphism]]s in different [[Variety (universal algebra)|varieties of groups]].<ref name="kn" />

==Education==
Gupta earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Jammu and Kashmir, a master's degree from the [[Aligarh Muslim University]], another master's degree from the [[Australian National University]], and a Ph.D. in 1967 from ANU under the supervision of Michael Frederick Newman.<ref name="kn">[https://cms.math.ca/Prizes/citations/kn2000.pdf 6th Krieger–Nelson Prize Lecture Citation], Canadian Mathematical Society, retrieved 2015-06-09.</ref><ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=47997}}</ref>

==Recognition==
She was elected to the [[Royal Society of Canada]] in 1991, and awarded the [[Krieger–Nelson Prize]] of the [[Canadian Mathematical Society]] in 2000.<ref name="kn"/>

==Personal==
Her husband, Narain Gupta (1936–2008) was also an ANU alumnus, and a distinguished professor of mathematics at the University of Manitoba.<ref>[http://passages.winnipegfreepress.com/passage-details/id-134184/name-Professor_Llb/order-publish_date%7CDESC,last_name%7CASC,first_name%7CASC/page-1654/ Obituary of Narain Gupta], ''[[Winnipeg Free Press]]'', 14 April 2008, retrieved 2015-06-09.</ref>
